step1_figure.circuit_type: Delta-Sigma Modulator (DSM) Sensing Circuit for CMOS Imagers
step1_figure.description: The circuit implements an NMOS-input delta-sigma modulator column sensing architecture for CMOS active pixel sensors (APS). It uses switched-capacitor charge packets from PMOS cup capacitors, integrates charge onto NMOS bucket capacitors through a PMOS current mirror, and feeds back the latched decision from a dynamic PMOS-imbalance comparator to balance reference and signal charge.

thermal_noise_hold_cap.description: RMS thermal noise voltage sampled onto the pixel hold capacitor (kT/C noise)

equation.explanation: Calculates the fundamental thermal noise voltage across the hold capacitance CH upon sampling.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_n_RMS = sqrt(1.38e-23 * 300 / 1e-12) = sqrt(4.14e-9) = 64.34 uV. Peak-to-peak is roughly 6 * V_RMS = 386 uV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard thermodynamic kT/C noise limit with 1 pF hold capacitor at room temperature.

shifted_reference_voltage.description: Effective input reference voltage level after NMOS threshold voltage drop

equation.explanation: The reference voltage VR applied to the NMOS voltage-to-current converter gate is level shifted by the NMOS threshold voltage VTHN.
equation.assumptions: NMOS operates as source follower / V-I converter with VR = 0.65 V

sky130_expected.calculation: In SKY130 tt corner, NMOS threshold V_THN = 0.42 V. With V_R = 0.65 V, V_R_shift = 0.65 - 0.42 = 0.23 V (230 mV).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by nominal supply and Vthn in SKY130.

voltage_resolution.description: Quantization voltage resolution of the DSM converter over N clock cycles

equation.explanation: The minimum distinguishable input voltage step for N clock cycles of integration.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_res = 230 mV / 100 = 2.3 mV (in the textbook with 50nm Vth=250mV, V_res was 400mV/100 = 4 mV).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Linear division of shifted reference voltage by N = 100 cycles.

switched_capacitor_resistance.description: Equivalent resistance of the switched-capacitor reference charge packet generator

equation.explanation: Effective resistance synthesized by transferring Ccup charge packets at clock frequency f.
equation.assumptions: f = 100 MHz (T = 10 ns), C_cup approx 15 fF (PMOS capacitor 5u/1u)

sky130_expected.calculation: With Cox = 8.4 fF/um^2 in SKY130 for 1.8V devices, C_cup = W*L*Cox = 5um * 1um * 8.4 fF/um^2 = 42 fF. R_R = 1 / (100 MHz * 42 fF) = 238 kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Switched-capacitor equivalent resistance derived from cup capacitor size and clock rate.

sensed_signal_voltage.description: Digital reconstruction of input signal intensity voltage based on DSM bitstream ones count

equation.explanation: The sensed signal shift is reconstructed linearly from the duty ratio M/N of reference charge pulses fed back.
equation.assumptions: N = 100 integration cycles, M is the number of active feedback cycles

sky130_expected.calculation: For Vi = 300 mV and VR = 650 mV, V_I_shift / V_R_shift is approximately 0.2 to 0.3, meaning M is around 20 to 30 pulses out of 100, giving V_I_shift_sensed = 230 mV * (25 / 100) = 57.5 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Proportional charge balancing of the delta-sigma sensing loop.

average_power.description: Total average power consumption of the column sensing circuit during active modulation

equation.explanation: Product of supply voltage and average supply current drawn by comparator and switched-capacitor network.
equation.assumptions: VDD = 1.8 V, measured over the active sensing window 500 ns to 1500 ns

sky130_expected.calculation: Average current is dominated by the comparator switching and current mirror (typically 20-50 uA). P_avg = 1.8 V * 30 uA = 54 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dynamic power of comparator clocked at 100 MHz plus small static branch currents.

step3_testbench.description: Transient simulation testbench of Figure 17.36 delta-sigma modulator sensing circuit over 100 clock cycles (500 ns to 1500 ns) measuring bucket capacitor voltages, output bitstream activity, and power.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Delta-Sigma Modulator Sensing Circuit for CMOS Imager (Fig. 17.36)
.lib ${SKY130_PDK} tt

* W/L Parameter definitions based on Fig. 17.36 annotations
.param W_xm1=1.0u  L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=1.0u  L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm3=5.0u  L_xm3=1.00u
.param W_xm4=1.0u  L_xm4=0.15u
.param W_xm5=1.0u  L_xm5=0.15u
.param W_xm6=1.0u  L_xm6=0.15u
.param W_xm7=2.0u  L_xm7=1.00u
.param W_xm8=1.0u  L_xm8=0.15u
.param W_xm9=1.0u  L_xm9=0.15u
.param W_xm10=1.0u L_xm10=0.15u
.param W_xm11=5.0u L_xm11=1.00u
.param W_xm12=2.0u L_xm12=1.00u
.param W_xm13=25.0u L_xm13=1.00u
.param W_xm14=25.0u L_xm14=1.00u
.param W_xm15=4.0u L_xm15=0.15u
.param W_xm16=4.0u L_xm16=0.15u
.param W_xm17=2.0u L_xm17=0.15u
.param W_xm18=2.0u L_xm18=0.15u
.param W_xm19=2.0u L_xm19=0.15u
.param W_xm20=2.0u L_xm20=0.15u
.param W_xm21=1.0u L_xm21=0.15u
.param W_xm22=1.0u L_xm22=0.15u
.param W_xm23=1.0u L_xm23=0.15u
.param W_xm24=1.0u L_xm24=0.15u

* Power Supplies and Bias Inputs
VDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
Vr Vr 0 DC 650m
Vi Vi 0 DC 300m

* Non-overlapping two-phase clocks (100 MHz, Period = 10 ns)
Vphi1 phi1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1.0n 0.1n 0.1n 3.0n 10.0n)
Vphi2 phi2 0 PULSE(0 1.8 6.0n 0.1n 0.1n 3.0n 10.0n)

* DUT Schematic Netlist (Fig. 17.36)
xm3 VDD N005 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm5 N006 phi2 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm7 vbuck vbucki VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
xm1 N005 phi2 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm2 N004 phi1 N006 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm4 N003 phi1 N005 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm6 N002 VDD N004 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
xm8 N001 Q N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
xm9 vbuck Vi N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
xm10 vbucki Vr N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
xm11 VDD N006 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
xm12 vbucki vbucki VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
xm13 0 vbuck 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm13} l={L_xm13}
xm14 0 vbucki 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm14} l={L_xm14}
xm15 n1 vbuck VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm15} l={L_xm15}
xm16 n2 vbucki VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm16} l={L_xm16}
xm17 n3 Out n1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm17} l={L_xm17}
xm18 n4 Outi n2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm18} l={L_xm18}
xm19 Outi phi2 n3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm19} l={L_xm19}
xm20 Out phi2 n4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm20} l={L_xm20}
xm21 Out Outi 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm21} l={L_xm21}
xm22 Outi Out 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm22} l={L_xm22}
xm23 Outi phi2 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm23} l={L_xm23}
xm24 Out phi2 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm24} l={L_xm24}
X_U1 Out Qi Q VDD 0 NOR_2
X_U2 Q Outi Qi VDD 0 NOR_2

.subckt NOR_2 A B Out VDD GND
  xm3 out B N001 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2.0u l=0.15u
  xm8 N001 A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2.0u l=0.15u
  xm11 out B GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.0u l=0.15u
  xm12 out A GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.0u l=0.15u
.ends NOR_2

.control
tran 0.05n 1500n uic

* Average bucket capacitor voltages over sensing window
meas tran v_buck_avg avg v(vbuck) from=500n to=1500n
meas tran v_bucki_avg avg v(vbucki) from=500n to=1500n

* Shifted reference voltage
let v_r_shift = 0.65 - 0.42
print v_r_shift

* Average power during sensing (500 ns to 1500 ns)
meas tran i_vdd_avg avg i(VDD) from=500n to=1500n
let p_avg = -i_vdd_avg * 1.8
print p_avg

* Modulator output Qi high fraction (used to determine sensed voltage)
meas tran v_qi_avg avg v(Qi) from=500n to=1500n
let pulse_ratio = v_qi_avg / 1.8
let m_count = (1 - pulse_ratio) * 100
let v_sensed = v_r_shift * (m_count / 100)
print pulse_ratio m_count v_sensed

quit
.endc
.end
